arguments_redacted.content: The `append_item` function in `src/accumulator.py` has a common Python state bug. The `bucket` parameter is initialized as an empty list only once when the function is defined, not each time it is called. This means that all calls to `append_item` will modify the same list, leading to unexpected behavior. A safe fix is to initialize the `bucket` parameter inside the function to ensure a new list is created for each call.
